import sys
from functools import reduce
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    input_file_name, regexp_extract, lit, col, to_date,
    regexp_replace
)
from pyspark.sql.types import DoubleType, IntegerType, LongType
from pyspark.sql import DataFrame

args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME'])

sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

bucket = "propelnoi-vijay-datalake"
output_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/market/insideairbnb/"

city_map = {
    "seattle": "Seattle",
    "chicago": "Chicago",
    "san_diego": "San Diego",
    "washington_dc": "Washington D C",
    "nashville": "Nashville",
    "boston": "Boston",
}

city_dfs = []

for city_folder, city_name in city_map.items():
    input_path = f"s3://{bucket}/raw/market/insideairbnb/{city_folder}/*.csv.gz"
    print(f"Reading city: {city_folder} from {input_path}")

    try:
        df = (
            spark.read
            .option("header", "true")
            .option("multiLine", "true")
            .option("quote", '"')
            .option("escape", '"')
            .option("mode", "PERMISSIVE")
            .option("ignoreLeadingWhiteSpace", "true")
            .option("ignoreTrailingWhiteSpace", "true")
            .csv(input_path)
        )

        raw_count = df.count()
        print(f"{city_folder} raw rows: {raw_count}")

        if raw_count == 0:
            print(f"{city_folder}: no rows found, skipping")
            continue

        df = df.withColumn("source_file", input_file_name())

        df = df.withColumn(
            "snapshot_date",
            to_date(
                regexp_extract(
                    col("source_file"),
                    r"listings_(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\.csv\.gz",
                    1
                ),
                "yyyy-MM-dd"
            )
        )

        # Clean price like "$120.00" -> 120.00
        df = df.withColumn("price", regexp_replace(col("price"), "[$,]", "").cast(DoubleType()))
        df = df.withColumn("minimum_nights", col("minimum_nights").cast(IntegerType()))
        df = df.withColumn("availability_365", col("availability_365").cast(IntegerType()))
        df = df.withColumn("number_of_reviews", col("number_of_reviews").cast(IntegerType()))
        df = df.withColumn("review_scores_rating", col("review_scores_rating").cast(DoubleType()))
        df = df.withColumn("latitude", col("latitude").cast(DoubleType()))
        df = df.withColumn("longitude", col("longitude").cast(DoubleType()))
        df = df.withColumn("listing_id", col("id").cast(LongType()))

        final_df = df.select(
            "listing_id",
            lit(city_name).alias("city"),
            lit("United States").alias("country"),
            col("neighbourhood_cleansed").alias("neighbourhood"),
            col("room_type"),
            col("price"),
            col("minimum_nights"),
            col("availability_365"),
            col("number_of_reviews"),
            col("review_scores_rating"),
            col("latitude"),
            col("longitude"),
            col("snapshot_date")
        )

        before_filter = final_df.count()
        print(f"{city_folder} rows before filter: {before_filter}")

        final_df = final_df.filter(
            col("listing_id").isNotNull() &
            col("city").isNotNull() &
            col("latitude").isNotNull() &
            col("longitude").isNotNull()
        )

        after_filter = final_df.count()
        print(f"{city_folder} rows after filter: {after_filter}")

        if after_filter > 0:
            city_dfs.append(final_df)
        else:
            print(f"{city_folder}: all rows dropped after filter")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error processing {city_folder}: {str(e)}")

if not city_dfs:
    raise Exception("No city data was successfully processed.")

combined_df = reduce(DataFrame.unionByName, city_dfs)

print(f"Total combined rows: {combined_df.count()}")

combined_df.write.mode("overwrite").partitionBy("city").parquet(output_path)

job.commit()
